finalText:
All 5 tests pass now.

The bug was in `token.js:7` — `isExpired` used `<` instead of `<=`, so a token with `exp` equal to the current time was treated as still valid, letting it slip past auth checks. Changed it to `<=`, matching the documented "expired the moment `exp` is reached" behavior. `secondsLeft` already relied on `isExpired`, so it's fixed too.
